name: Urwa ibn al-Ward
bio: Urwa was a pre-Islamic poet and horseman of Abs, a branch of Ghatafan. He was called Urwa of the Sa'alik, the impoverished raiders he gathered around him and supported when they came home empty-handed. The caliph Abd al-Malik is reported to have put his generosity in the same class as Hatim’s. His collected poems survive with commentary attributed to Ibn al-Sikkit. Al-Zirikli places his death around 594 CE.
